description: This file is a CMake script designed to locate and configure the IARMBus library within a build system. It defines variables for include directories, libraries, and flags needed to use IARMBus, and handles the detection process using CMake's find_package and related commands.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Searches for specified packages, such as PkgConfig and handle detection logic.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds the library files for IARMBus.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Locates necessary header files for IARMBus and related components.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets variable values, including cache variables for include directories and libraries.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes other CMake scripts, e.g., FindPackageHandleStandardArgs.

methods.name: FIND_PACKAGE_HANDLE_STANDARD_ARGS
methods.description: Handles standardized package detection and reporting.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to be hidden in CMake GUI.
